rationale: The prompt materially requires complete minutes schema including metadata, decisions rationale, action criteria, risks, references, and version history. The anchored # Meeting Notes Distiller scopes the source-visible material to Use when given a meeting transcript or raw notes to produce a structured summary — decisions made, action items (with owner + due date), risks/blockers, open questions, and a follow-up email draft. Vendor-neutral; works; this is a meaningful neighbouring route, but it does not supply the stated requirement as an independently executable output.
